project: Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 PC Port
approach: Static recompilation of the Xbox 360 XBLA version to native PC code using ReXGlue
notes: Native Windows build with the TRG launcher, high frame rates, local achievements and offline leaderboards. Cheats with an in-game menu, portable user data and launcher window state persistence. Experimental Linux/Steam Deck AppImage, not yet tested on real hardware
